ethno-e1.text: Ethnobotanicals: The plant medicines in this protocol are iboga (an African root bark) and psilocybin mushrooms. Both are illegal in many jurisdictions and carry risks, and iboga can be dangerous for your heart. So never combine iboga with most medications (especially heart & psych meds), and if you take any medication, check it against my full iboga guide here first (the iboga microdosing protocol is here).

rule1.name: The Rule by itself, with his answer 66 (no telling people to leave a partner)
rule1.text: The Rule: Seek "Boring Love", meaning parallel play (like reading next to someone) and touch that feels safe to you. The other kind, "Exciting Love", is the rush of a new romance or high-stakes drama, which spikes Phasic Dopamine and puts the armor right back up. So this may not be a good time to jump into either one, though there's no need to leave the partner you have.

uri-u1.name: The uridine caution, small step 1: his 69 (a third of the old dose to start)
uri-u1.text: Uridine (the UMP in this protocol) doesn't raise serotonin, so its caution is a different one, and it comes from experience like Scott's below, since I don't have studies on it: within a day of starting uridine, psychedelics can hit harder, visuals included. So do not take UMP on the same day as a psychedelic trip, and on your first trip once you're on it, start with a third of your old psychedelic dose. It may also make your dreams more vivid and your cravings weaker, which are the benefits you're hoping for.
